headline: New Jersey would let office prevent algorithm discrimination
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

New Jersey would give the Office of Algorithmic Civil Rights the power to prevent discrimination in the use of algorithms. Not passed. It cites the fear that an algorithm decides who gets hired, housed, or lent to.

115 measures in 32 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

53 measures in 14 jurisdictions cite the fear that an algorithm decides who gets hired, housed, or lent to.

2,215 measures tracked. 748 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
